skills.name: Spell Curse
skills.description: Khufra activates the spell left by Esmeralda every 12 seconds, enhancing her next basic attack. Improved Basic Attack gains additional attack range [Cast Range: 4.9] and deals []. Also slows the target by 30% for 1.5 seconds and heals Khufra for 8% of her maximum HP on a hit. Each time Khufra applies a control effect to an enemy hero with her skill, the cooldown of Spell Curse is reduced by 4 seconds.

skills.name: Tyrant's Revenge
skills.description: Khufra pulls the bandage on her arms to launch herself in the specified direction, dealing 50-100 plus 7% of her Max HP physical damage to all enemy units in the path. When blinking far away or encountering the first enemy Hero, Khufra will immediately stop, dealing 50-100 plus 7% of his maximum Physical damage to nearby enemies, then knocking them into the air for up to 1.1 seconds.

skills.name: Bouncing Ball
skills.description: Khufra uses a bandage to wrap herself in a bouncy magic ball, increasing her own physical and magical defense by 30% to 100&. Enemies attempting to use their blink skills to move through Khufra will be knocked into the air. [time required] Every time the Magic Bouncing Ball hits the ground, it will deal magic damage equal to 50-100 plus 3% of its maximum HP to nearby enemies and Slow them by 80%. Lasts 0.2 seconds.

skills.name: Tyrant's Rage
skills.description: Khufra brings all enemy targets around him towards his front, dealing and slowing them for 1.25 to 1.75 seconds. If enemies are knocked against walls, additional physical damage equal to 150% of this ability's damage will be dealt to them and they will be stunned instead of slowed.
